name: Ultimate Humungousaur
abilities: Hands transform into bio-gatling missile launchers (missiles or bullet-sized pellets)
Enhanced speed, agility and reflexes for his size
weaknesses: Huge size makes tight spaces difficult
Cannot change size like Humungousaur (per Dwayne McDuffie)
summary: The evolved Vaxasaurian: an ankylosaur-armoured, mace-tailed powerhouse whose knuckles unfold into missile launchers. Ben's go-to Ultimate brawler in Ultimate Alien.
traits: First Ultimate form ever seen on-screen (used by Albedo)
Only Ultimate to appear in three Classic shows
Voiced by Dee Bradley Baker (AF/UA), John DiMaggio (OV, Albedo)
notableFeats: Ben's first use: briefly fought P'Andor, Buzz, Surgeon and Hammer, collapsing a cave (Too Hot to Handle)
Knocked Overlord (Captain Nemesis) around with his tail (Hero Time)
Battled Ultimate Kevin, though he lost (The Enemy of My Enemy)
Defeated Antonio, easily dodging his attacks (Girl Trouble)
Fought Sir George to a standstill before making an agreement about Dagon (Solitary Alignment)
As Albedo: withstood Atomix's Nuclear Punch and an atomic blast (For a Few Brains More); Albedo's version also beat an army of Humungousaur Bioids only by weight of numbers (The Final Battle: Part 2)

appearances.designNotes: Burly humanoid dinosaur with camo-green skin and dark-blue ankylosaur-style armour on head, back, chest and torso; helmet with three silver spikes and two black side horns; silver knuckle barrels that unfold into four-barrel missile launchers; black claws; blue spiked mace tail; green eyes and green evolved Ultimatrix symbol on chest (Albedo's AF version is identical but with red eyes/symbol).

image.label: UA
image.notes: Infobox image labelled UA; visually verified green eyes and green Ultimatrix symbol (Ben's version).

scoring.rationale: Ten times Humungousaur's strength (DVD data), missile barrages that knock out a Petrosapien, and armour that (as Albedo) tanked Atomix's nuclear punch and blast; the sentient version lifted and threw Way Big. Loses to Ultimate Kevin, is grounded by electricity, cannot grow, and his bulk is a liability indoors.

notes: ALIEN FORCE: only Albedo used Ultimate Humungousaur (The Final Battle: Parts 1-2, red eyes/red Ultimatrix symbol) - no AF appearance record for Ben. The infobox AF image 'Ultimate Humongousaur 1.PNG' is Albedo's (verified red symbol) and must NOT be used for Ben.

OMNIVERSE: only Albedo (Negative Ultimate Humungousaur, techno-organic redesign) used it - The Ultimate Heist, A Fistful of Brains, For a Few Brains More, And Then There Were None (non-speaking). No Ben used it in OV, so no OV appearance. Infobox OV image 'Negative Ultimate Humungousaur.png' is Albedo's.

In 'Ben 10,000 Returns' Ultimate Ben channelled Ultimate Humungousaur's strength (his body bulked up) without transforming; the wiki lists it under 'Ben 10,000's Transformations' but it is not counted here as a separate appearance.
Ben's first on-screen use is 'Too Hot to Handle' (UA S1); debut field records the wiki first appearance (Albedo, AF).
Wiki lists a dream-figment cameo in 'Night of the Living Nightmare' (Albedo's dream) - not counted.
In UA the missiles were described as kinetically unstable bone fragments; the OV redesign made them look like conventional missiles.

Sentient Ultimates storyline (UA S3, 'The Ultimate Sacrifice'): the six most-used Ultimate forms (Humungousaur, Swampfire, Spidermonkey, Big Chill, Cannonbolt, Echo Echo) gained sentience inside the Ultimatrix and demanded freedom; Ben offered his life, Azmuth freed them to their own world and reworked the Ultimatrix so Ultimates are 'empty shells' again.

Ultimate forms are artificial by-products of the Ultimatrix's evolutionary function (added by Albedo): the DNA is run through a simulated worst-case scenario over millions of theoretical years to force combat-oriented evolution. They are not natural Codon Stream species, and the Omniverse Omnitrix has no evolutionary function, so Ben never regains them after UA (Derrick J. Wyatt).
